selected_evidence.summary: The persistent GRUB setting and generated entries contain audit=1; after reboot, /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and dmesg reports audit enabled and initialized.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were unchanged before and after the modification.

Healthy baseline boot ID 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa was captured, restart was acknowledged, and recovered boot ID 14370a23-08dc-490a-b95b-6646f9b6f110 proves a restart. Post-restart system state was running with zero failed units.
